item.title: Toph gameplay trailer for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game released
item.description: <p>Despite <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2024/dec/03/avatar-fighting-game-canceled/">being canceled</a>, the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/oct/12/avatar-legends-fighting-game-trailer/">Avatar fighting game was surprisingly revived</a> last year, and now we get to see more of the project in action.</p> <p>Gameplay Group International just dropped the gameplay trailer for Toph in Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game.</p>

item.title: The obscenely overpowered Mecha Sonic from Super Mario Bros. Z has been added to Super Smash Bros. Ultimate via modding
item.description: <p>There are a total of 86 characters in <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/ssbu/'>Super Smash Bros. Ultimate</a>. It's crazy to think that there's only one fighter who hails from Sega's Sonic the Hedgehog, that being Sonic himself.</p> <p>The modder known as <a href='https://gamebanana.com/mods/495584'>Sintomatikoa</a> remedy this by adding Mecha Sonic to the roster. However, it would seem that this version of Mecha Sonic is based on his appearance in the popular flash series by Alvin-Ear

item.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage free play weekend going down now
item.description: <p>This will hopefully be a big year for Virtua Fighter, and anyone can get their hands on the current game right now.</p> <p>Sega is currently running a special free play weekend for Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage right now (at least for one system).</p>

item.title: Akali and Senna revealed as next champions for 2XKO as Director discusses future of the game
item.description: <p>This week came with the unfortunate news that <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/09/2xko-riot-half-layoffs/">Riot Games is laying off around half of 2XKO's development team</a>, but it seems there's still quite a bit more content in the works for the title.</p> <p>Riot just revealed the next two champions coming to <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/2xko/">2XKO</a>'s first year while also discussing new features and the future outlook of the League of Legends fighting game

item.title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game global closed alpha test announced for later this month including Toph
item.description: <p>After coming out of nowhere, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/oct/12/avatar-legends-fighting-game-trailer/">Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game</a> is shaping up to be one of the most interesting looking fighters coming out this year, and now more people are going to be able to play it.</p> <p>Gameplay Group International announced today that Avatar Legends is receiving a global closed alpha test in the coming weeks.</p>

item.title: Tekken: Dark Resurrection announced for PlayStation 5 and 4, but no, not THAT one
item.description: <p>There was a ton of fighting game news that popped up this week, but there was one reveal that didn't quite get the same amount of attention or positive reception.</p> <p>During the busy <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/12/state-play-marvel-tokon/">State of Play event</a>, Bandai Namco announced that Tekken: Dark Resurrection is coming back to modern PlayStation consoles, however, it wasn't in the way that many fans were hoping for.</p>

item.title: All 12 groups for the Capcom Cup 12 have been determined via drawing
item.description: <p>We're approaching the end of the 12th Capcom Pro Tour. The finale of this circuit, Capcom Cup 12, is scheduled to begin on March 11 and last through March 15, 2026.</p> <p>At this point, we know the <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/25/capcom-cup-qualified-players/'>48 competitors that have qualified</a> to compete at the Capcom Cup 12 finale. One of these players will be taking home $1,000,000 as the first place prize.</p>

item.description: <p><a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/12/wolverine-announced-marvel-tokon/'>Wolverine, Magik and Danger</a> were recently revealed to be part of the Unbreakable X-Men team headed by Storm in <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/jun/04/marvel-tokon-fighting-arcsys/'>Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls</a>.
